text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch fo their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives telegram from Canadian trade delegation in Iraq
- Festival in Brussels in support of Iraqi children
- Interview with Defence Minister General Sultan Hashim Ahmed
- Iraq's minister of higher education meets IAEA president in Vienna
- Sudan says Iraq has the right to defend itself
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Vietnam seeks expansion of economic and industrial cooperation with Iraq
- European countries back Boutros-Ghali's bid for a second term
- President Saddam Hussein's representative attends international meeting on solar energy in Zimbabwe.
- France warned U.S. against mounting another aggression on Iraq
